scope: SSH, RDP login and profiles, RSS, Web, Books, Dots, Care; review of legacy hub and native RDP renderer
method: Read current canonical working files, preserving existing dirty changes.
Render host previews at 1404x1872, including forms, settings and dialogs.
Review hierarchy, contrast, target size, action discoverability, long text and keyboard occlusion.
Add host UI layout regressions, then validate using touch events on the physical tablet.
Compare private state digests before and after tablet scenarios.

changes.problem: Close buttons differed in size and type; some option rows were too shallow.
changes.resolution: 176x76px Close, 8px radius; 16pt action labels; finger-sized important controls, clearer disabled states.

changes.problem: Six commands squeezed app identity and the native input editor into a single row; panels could compete; the hold timer used unqualified touch state.
changes.resolution: Persistent identity and Close above a five-command strip; separate input editor; mutually exclusive Sessions, Display and Shortcuts without dismissing an already-open keyboard; emphasized Open and Save; correctly scoped hold state prevents a left click after a right click.

changes.problem: Editing kept a redundant saved-profile list above the fields; Save validation could be outside the viewport.
changes.resolution: Contextual editor heading, saved list hidden only during editing, fixed opaque Save/Cancel dock with validation feedback; disabled unavailable Edit/Delete.

changes.problem: 54px option bar, tiny status and labels that described the next action rather than the current state.
changes.resolution: 88px bar with 76px actions, View: Mobile/Computer and Pictures: on/off, visible zoom percentage; preserved vector Back/Reload.

changes.problem: Cramped source names and 50px Remove targets competed; article metadata was too small; add-feed view lacked Close.
changes.resolution: Wider source rail, taller source/article rows, larger metadata and two-tap Remove; Close on add-feed view, clearer loading and empty-state copy.

changes.problem: Sort choices were smaller than other controls, search wording omitted research topics, modal explanation and status were small and shelf hints persisted on other views.
changes.resolution: Larger actions and sort picklist, contextual guidance, clearer search and input hints, keyboard-inset fallback, more readable deletion/status copy; reading position and storage-error visibility preserved.

changes.problem: New-game dialog occupied nearly the whole display while much of it was blank.
changes.resolution: Content-sized centered dialog and larger standard action buttons; no rule, saved-game or board-dimension changes.

changes.problem: Disabled actions were faded twice; fixed cards risked overlap with long status/release messages; security explanations were tiny.
changes.resolution: Single readable disabled ink, consistent controls, content-sized status and uninstall panels, larger safety copy and bounded kinetic scrolling.

limitations: Tablet Qt lacks the Accessible attached object available on the host. Optional annotations were removed after a physical load failure; a source regression now prevents reintroducing them.
Host raster previews are not photographs of the e-ink display. Tablet screenshots were deliberately not taken because capture has previously stalled or crashed this firmware.
The native RDP bitmap renderer remains different from Qt text. No engine/network rewrite is bundled with a visual cleanup.
This audit does not remove the previously documented synchronous RDP connection and transport byte-budget risks.

evidence.safeActionScope: No authenticated user server was changed. Native Care opened and cancelled uninstall; it did not install or uninstall. RDP/SSH CRUD used isolated fixtures. The test book download and test games were discarded by restoring original user state.

validationCorrections: Removed host-only Accessible annotations after the tablet rejected them at load time; added a regression.
Fixed the SSH hold timer's touch-state scope; verified right click without an extra left click.
Preserved an already-open SSH system keyboard when switching terminal tools.
Updated physical Web zoom taps to the center of the enlarged option controls rather than their old positions.
